sources.title: Google Scholar
sources.snippet: Google Scholar provides a simple way to broadly search for scholarly literature. Search across a wide variety of disciplines and sources: articles, theses, books, abstracts and court opinions.

sources.title: DocAI — AI Document Extractor
sources.snippet: Upload any document and instantly extract structured data — dates, amounts, names, clauses, and more. Powered by free, open-source AI. No API keys required.

sources.title: AI Paper Checker | Free Plagiarism & Grade Check
sources.snippet: Improve your grades with our free AI paper checker. Detect plagiarism, fix grammar errors, and spot AI-generated content instantly.

sources.title: Document AI documentation - Google Cloud
sources.snippet: Document AI is a document understanding platform that takes unstructured data from documents and transforms it into structured data, making it easier to understand, analyze, and consume. Document AI uses machine learning and Google Cloud to help you create scalable, end-to-end, cloud-based document processing applications.

sources.title: Document AI - Google Cloud
sources.snippet: The Document AI solutions suite includes pretrained models for document processing, Workbench for custom models, and Warehouse to search and store.
